references.text: The Lord commands Moses to make the tabernacle exactly according to the pattern shown to him, establishing the foundation for the obedience described in Exodus 39:42.
The Israelites completed all the work on the tabernacle exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses, reflecting the same theme of obedience to God's commands.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him, a parallel to how the children of Israel carried out the work in obedience to the Lord's command.
The command to keep all that the Lord has commanded, without adding or taking away, reflects the principle of exact obedience in carrying out the work.
The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses, following the same pattern of obedience to God's commands.
Moses was warned to do everything according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain, a New Testament reference to the principle of obedience to God's detailed instructions.
Both verses confirm Israel's total obedience in fulfilling God's specific commands.
Shows that the principle of total obedience applies regardless of which worship service or event is involved.
